verdict.reading: REGISTERED CONTROL (a) DID NOT FAIL in any set or basis: every nontrivial fraction lies at or below a uniformly random subspace of the same dimension (squared fractions track dim/n for every component). By the registered rule the fraction is dimension counting, and 'differs by X% in directions none of the references can distinguish' is not supported as a property of these tables. Control (c), stated as a finding: see control_c_percentile_rank; a rank below 50 means the published difference is not enriched in the unidentified directions even within the tables it occupies. Per the user's registered ruling, Type B's claim rests on Experiment 2.

rule.effect_on_expectation_user: the user's 'comparable' expectation is then simply wrong, and the artifact says so
rule.effect_on_main_claim_user: none: the claim at the published points stands or falls on its own CI either way
rule.operational_note_claude: 2000 bootstrap draws; each resamples sequences with replacement (one resample shared by both arms: the arms fold the same sequences) and, independently, the 8 directions of each arm with replacement; the statistic is mean genuine changed-MFE fraction (null) minus (contrast); 95% percentile CI. Evaluated at every grid scale at or above the floor with at least one changed MFE in either arm. Overall: 'less' if the CI is below 0 at every such scale, 'more' if above 0 at every such scale, 'comparable' if it contains 0 at every such scale, otherwise 'mixed', with the per-scale results reported.
rule.reading_if_it_fires_user: the references' blindness to these directions largely carries over to competing structures on the same sequences
rule.reason: the smoke test hinted that null directions may move predictions much less than contrast at equal norm (0/50 vs 2/50 changed MFEs; mean D_bpp 0.00036 vs 0.0025; one direction each, 50 sequences: a reason to register the branch, not evidence)
rule.rule_user: 'less': the null-minus-contrast difference in genuine changed-MFE fraction has a 95% CI below 0, bootstrapped over sequences and directions

floor.rule: the smallest grid ||delta|| at which the rounding-caused share of changed MFEs, pooled over the null directions, is <= 5%; points below it are drawn hatched and not interpreted

amendment_2_langdon_intrinsic_control_us.basis_note_claude: the MODEL-level intrinsic directions (analytic_directions over all reachable columns, not the TR0+TS0-restricted ones), restricted to each table's shared support and orthonormalised; their exactness is checked on the 23,741 generating-set rows (max |G g| <= 1e-9 before restriction)
amendment_2_langdon_intrinsic_control_us.canonicaliser_user: canonicalise toward Turner 2004 along the 2 intrinsic directions: g* = argmin ||delta + g|| over their span on the shared support; report ||delta|| vs ||delta + g*||, and per table the rms per-entry difference before and after for the six tables: how much of the apparent per-entry difference goes away. Langdon is the case of interest; Andronescu and Turner 1999 alongside.
amendment_2_langdon_intrinsic_control_us.control: per-table constant-shift control: keep each of the six tables' |mean shift|, flip the signs; all 2^6 = 64 sign patterns enumerated exactly; the statistic is the intrinsic fraction of the per-table-constant part of delta; report the true pattern's rank among the 64 and the per-table mean shifts themselves (kcal/mol)
amendment_2_langdon_intrinsic_control_us.execution: scripts/turner_typeb_langdon_gauge.py, its own artifact (runs/2026-10-12_turner_typeb_langdon_gauge), one core, while the fold runs; it never writes the Type B artifact
amendment_2_langdon_intrinsic_control_us.status: registered after seeing Experiment 1; EXPLORATORY whatever it returns
amendment_2_langdon_intrinsic_control_us.structure_note_claude: the 2 intrinsic directions are per-table constant shifts (N1: +1 on every mismatchH entry, -1 on every hairpin[3..30]; N2: +1 on every mismatchI, mismatch1nI, mismatch23I entry, -2 on every internal_loop[4..30]), so delta's intrinsic component is set entirely by delta's per-table means over those six tables. Any revision that shifts those tables by constants projects onto them, whether or not the shifts satisfy the gauge relations.
amendment_2_langdon_intrinsic_control_us.why_user: if it holds, the paper's most concrete Type A example: a published table sitting 3.8 kcal/mol along an exact gauge direction; and the natural test of the canonicaliser

amendments_2026_10_12.experiment_1_control_c_correction: control (c) for Langdon 2018 rotated delta into 359 used columns where delta is undefined (INF in Langdon); restricted to the shared support before the fold, the superseded values kept in experiment_1.corrections

experiment_1_outcome.attribution: registered under prior_claude; the user records them as their guesses too
priors_failed: every table's nontrivial fraction clears control (a)'s 99th percentile: FAILED, no table clears it in either basis
Andronescu 2007's nontrivial fraction exceeds Turner 1999's: FAILED (0.180 vs 0.184, TR0+TS0 basis)
experiment_1_outcome.what_survives_user: calibration: Andronescu's P_nt delta is 21.0 kcal/mol of real difference between published tables, all of it in directions no TR0+TS0 reference can see. Experiment 2 asks whether moving that far changes predictions; if it does: 'two tables that agree on all 11,955 reference energies disagree on X% of predicted MFEs, at a distance the size of what separates published tables'. No enrichment is needed for it.
experiment_1_outcome.why_none_was_expected_user: TR0+TS0's null space comes from TR0+TS0 and none of these tables was fitted to it; enrichment would be expected only against each table's own training null space, which cannot be rebuilt; not pursued before the scope freeze

amendments_2026_10_12.null_arm_leak_assertion_user: for every null-kind point, A.(theta_r - theta0) must equal A.r: |A.delta| <= 1e-9 kcal/mol per kcal/mol of ||delta|| on all 11,955 references, asserted when the points are built (the reference-energy identity in the worker holds for any theta_r, so it cannot stop a non-null 'null' direction)
amendments_2026_10_12.pred_recheck: fold-analyse refuses unless the artifact's predictions equal this PRED
amendments_2026_10_12.timing: written 2026-10-12 after Experiment 1 and the fold smoke test were seen, before the full fold was launched; written into the artifact by --phase amend

bases.C2: max |A N| <= 1e-9 for the intrinsic and the nontrivial bases
bases.basis_invariance: every random direction is drawn as P g = N N^T g with g Gaussian on the used columns, so no number depends on the basis's rotation
bases.rule: recompute with the registered functions (Extractor with exact reconstruction against eval_structure, build_matrix over the reachable columns, qr_null on the used columns, analytic_directions removed as in turner_nullspace_rfam.analyse); the dimensions must equal the registered ones exactly, or the run stops

experiment_1_projection.also_reported_claude: the full orthogonal split (coverage, intrinsic, nontrivial, identified) with squared fractions summing to 1; the full-null fraction; the per-table distribution of delta itself; the metric-free rms of A delta
experiment_1_projection.control_a_user: MUST FAIL: a uniformly random subspace of R^n of the same dimension. Its squared fraction is Beta(k/2, (n-k)/2) exactly, so quantiles are computed, not sampled. The true fraction must exceed the control's 99th percentile, or the number is dimension counting.
experiment_1_projection.control_b_claude: reported: uniform within the used columns (where the null space lives), the same exact Beta, scaled by ||delta_used|| / ||delta||
experiment_1_projection.control_c_claude: reported AS A STATED FINDING whatever it returns (user's ruling): table-matched, 1000 draws. A random rotation inside each table's block of used columns, applied to the basis, keeps every vector's per-table loading; equivalently delta's per-table blocks are rotated at random and projected on the true basis. If the true fraction does not clear the 99th percentile the finding is: 'the overlap is explained by both objects living in the internal-loop tables', and Type B's claim rests on Experiment 2.
experiment_1_projection.prior_claude: every set's nontrivial fraction clears control (a)'s 99th percentile; uncertain against (c); Andronescu 2007's fraction exceeds Turner 1999's (fitted, not revised)
experiment_1_projection.rule_user: for each shipped full RNA set other than Turner 2004, delta = theta_X - theta_2004 on the shared columns; project onto the nontrivial null space of TR0+TS0 and of Rfam; report ||P_N delta|| (kcal/mol), ||P_N delta|| / ||delta||, and the per-table breakdown of the null component. Assert first that the column sets are identical; if not, restrict to the shared support and say so.
experiment_1_projection.sentences_user: Andronescu 2007: 'a published machine-learned parameter table differs from Turner 2004 by X% in directions that none of the 11,955 bpRNA reference structures can distinguish'; Turner 1999: the companion sentence on successive revisions of the same model

experiment_2_fold.A: TR0+TS0 (user's choice 2026-10-12): every reference structure in the corpus keeps exactly its energy, so no train/test framing; all 11,970 TR0+TS0 sequences kept by the loader are folded
experiment_2_fold.attribution_user_and_claude: for every sequence whose MFE changed (s0 -> s1): exact unrounded E(s) = c(s).(theta0 + delta) + offset(s); genuine if E(s1) <= E(s0), rounding-caused otherwise. Reported at EVERY point: the number changed and the genuine share
experiment_2_fold.claim_rule: at the three published-component points, if above the floor: the genuine changed-MFE fraction's bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0
experiment_2_fold.claim_user: we perturb along a direction invisible to every one of the 11,955 observed reference structures, and the predictions change anyway, because folding a sequence evaluates structures nobody observed
experiment_2_fold.comparison_of_interest_user: genuine changed-MFE fraction (and F1, D_bpp), null vs contrast, at matched ||delta||, every grid point. Comparable movement is the expected outcome and not a failure: the claim is that these directions are invisible to the fitting data (the leak check) while visible to the predictor (this comparison). If comparable, the reading is 'they move predictions as much as any int-table perturbation of that size while no reference sees them', not 'unidentified directions are special'. Expectation, user's: comparable.

directions.amendment_user_2026_10_12: contrast raised from 4 to 8 directions: null vs contrast is a registered comparison of interest, so the arm doing the interpretive work needs the same number of draws as the null arm. If the box is busy, drop the lowest one or two grid points (below the expected floor, hatched anyway) to buy back the cost.
directions.contrast: 8 random unit directions in the identified complement restricted to ['int22', 'int21', 'int11', 'bulge'] (g Gaussian on those used columns, nontrivial component removed; the intrinsic directions have no support there), seeds SeedSequence([20261012, 2, j])
directions.excluded_by_design: coverage directions (columns A never uses) are also invisible to A but are excluded: entries never observed are a weaker object
directions.null: 8 random unit directions in the TR0+TS0 nontrivial null space, seeds SeedSequence([20261012, 1, i])
directions.published: unit(P_nt delta_X) for the three shipped sets, TR0+TS0 basis

experiment_2_fold.execution: 12 workers sharded by sequence, each computing its baseline once; driver under setsid, completion read from recorded status; uptime checked before launch; full run only on the user's go
experiment_2_fold.floor_rule: the smallest grid ||delta|| at which the rounding-caused share of changed MFEs, pooled over the null directions, is <= 5%; points below it are drawn hatched and not interpreted
experiment_2_fold.gap_user: once under theta0: the gap from the MFE to the best other structure (Wuchty subopt, delta 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 dcal until a second structure appears); its distribution and the degenerate fraction (gap 0)
experiment_2_fold.grid_rule: ||delta|| = 0.125 * 2^k kcal/mol, k = 0, 1, ..., up to the first value >= 2 * max_X ||P_nt delta_X|| (TR0+TS0 basis); fixed by the project phase before any fold; each published component is also run at its own norm (the headline points)
experiment_2_fold.guards_user_and_claude: per worker, per loaded file: turner_par.loaded() forces a table rebuild; params_match on the first compound; a CARRY CHECK: the 5 generating-set rows with the largest |c(s).(theta_r - theta0)| evaluate to c(s).theta_r exactly and that change is nonzero (params_match's entries do not include int22/int21/int11, so it alone cannot see a stale table here). Any failure stops the run; nothing is repaired.
experiment_2_fold.leak_scaling_note_claude: the per-entry rounding residual is <= 0.5 dcal at every scale, so the leak saturates rather than grows with ||delta||; the floor is defined by attribution instead of a leak-gap crossing (accepted by the user)
experiment_2_fold.leak_user: at every point: eval_structure of all 11,955 references under the loaded file must equal c(s).theta_r exactly (integer dcal; must hold); the leak c(s).(theta_r - theta0) reported as median, 95th percentile and max in kcal/mol beside every divergence value
experiment_2_fold.metrics: per sequence against the unperturbed fold: MFE base-pair F1 (1 if both empty), MFE changed, D_bpp = (1/L) sum_{i<j} |p_ij - p'_ij|; F1 against the reference, baseline and perturbed (reported, no prediction); means with bootstrap 95% CIs over sequences and by length tercile
experiment_2_fold.per_point: theta_r = round(theta0 + delta) written by scripts/turner_par.write_par; the rounding residual and ||theta_r - theta0 - delta|| / ||delta|| recorded
experiment_2_fold.prior_claude: floor between 0.5 and 2 kcal/mol; genuine changed-MFE fraction at the Andronescu point well above 0

predictions.registered: 2026-10-12, before bases, projection or any fold were computed

scope.d2_out_of_scope: with dangles 2 ViennaRNA stores min(x, 0) for mismatchExt, mismatchM, dangle5, dangle3 (runs/2026-10-12_turner_par_writer V2): the model is not linear in theta there and the null-space analysis does not transfer
scope.metric_note_claude: the null space is metric-free; an orthogonal projection and its fraction are not. Metric: Euclidean in raw parameter-file coordinates, kcal/mol. Reported beside it, metric-free: the rms change of A's reference energies, A delta.
scope.wording_rule_claude: the 426 (214) are directions that THESE reference structures cannot distinguish; only the 2 intrinsic directions are invisible to every possible structure. Sentences say 'none of the 11,955 bpRNA reference structures can distinguish', never 'no structure data can distinguish'.
